```{r, setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_knit$set(root.dir = '.')
```


```{r}
library(biomaRt)
source("../lib_obo.R")
source("../lib_kegg.R")
```



# From Ensembl

## Retreive GeneID mapping table from Ensembl using biomaRt package
```{r}
mart <- biomaRt::useEnsembl('genes','hsapiens_gene_ensembl')
gene_info <- getBM(
  mart = mart,
  attributes = c("ensembl_gene_id","entrezgene_id","hgnc_id","external_gene_name","gene_biotype","chromosome_name","start_position","end_position","strand")
)
gene_info$position_GRCh38 <- as.character(with(gene_info,GRanges(chromosome_name,IRanges(start_position,end_position),strand = strand)))
gene_info$strand <- gene_info$start_position <- gene_info$end_position <- NULL
gene_info <- as(gene_info,"DataFrame")
```



## GO terms

```{r}
gene_info$go_ids <- local({
  x <- getBM(
          mart = mart,
          attributes = c("ensembl_gene_id","go_id")
        ) |>
        subset(go_id != "")
  x$ensembl_gene_id <- factor(x$ensembl_gene_id,unique(gene_info$ensembl_gene_id))
  x <- splitAsList(x$go_id,x$ensembl_gene_id)
  unique(x[gene_info$ensembl_gene_id])
})
```


```{r}
gene_info$goslim_goa_accession <- local({
  x <- getBM(
    mart = mart,
    attributes = c("ensembl_gene_id","goslim_goa_accession")
  ) |>
  subset(goslim_goa_accession != "")
  x$ensembl_gene_id <- factor(x$ensembl_gene_id,unique(gene_info$ensembl_gene_id))
  x <- splitAsList(x$goslim_goa_accession,x$ensembl_gene_id)
  x[gene_info$ensembl_gene_id] |> unique() |> unname()
})
```

Also retreive the ontology
```{r,eval=FALSE}
download.file("http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/go/go-basic.obo","data/go-basic.obo")
```

# Reactome pathways
```{r,eval=FALSE}
download.file("https://reactome.org/download/current/Ensembl2Reactome.txt","data/Ensembl2Reactome.txt")
download.file("https://reactome.org/download/current/ReactomePathways.txt","data/ReactomePathways.txt")
download.file("https://reactome.org/download/current/ReactomePathwaysRelation.txt","data/ReactomePathwaysRelation.txt")
```


```{r}
gene_info$reactom_id <- local({
  x <- read.table(
    "data/Ensembl2Reactome.txt",sep = "\t",comment="",header=FALSE,quote="",
    colClasses = c("character","character","NULL","NULL","character","character")
  )
  names(x) <- c("ensembl_id","reactome_id","evidence","organism")
  x <- x[x$organism %in% "Homo sapiens",]
  x$ensembl_id <- factor(x$ensembl_id,unique(gene_info$ensembl_gene_id))
  x <- splitAsList(x$reactome_id,x$ensembl_id) |> unique()
  x[gene_info$ensembl_gene_id] |> unname()
})
```




# IUPHAR categories
```{r,eval=FALSE}
download.file("https://www.guidetopharmacology.org/DATA/targets_and_families.tsv","data/iuphar_targets_and_families.tsv")
```


```{r}
gene_info$iuphar_family <- local({
  x <- read.table("data/iuphar_targets_and_families.tsv",sep="\t",quote='"',comment="",skip = 1,header=TRUE,check.names = FALSE)

  # Check that family is a subgroup of type
  stopifnot(max(lengths(unique(splitAsList(x$Type,x$`Family name`))))==1)
  
  x$`Human Ensembl Gene` <- factor(x$`Human Ensembl Gene`,unique(gene_info$ensembl_gene_id))
  x$iuphar_family <- paste(x$Type,x$`Family name`,sep="///")
  iuphar_family <- splitAsList(x$iuphar_family,x$`Human Ensembl Gene`) |> unique()

  iuphar_family[gene_info$ensembl_gene_id] |> unname()
})
```




# KEGG
```{r,eval=FALSE}
# Ontology
download.file("https://rest.kegg.jp/get/br:br08901/json","data/kegg_brite_br08901_pathways.json")
download.file("https://rest.kegg.jp/get/br:ko00002/json","data/kegg_brite_ko00002_modules.json")

# Human annotations
download.file("https://rest.kegg.jp/link/pathway/hsa","data/kegg_link_hsa_pathway.tsv")
download.file("https://rest.kegg.jp/link/module/hsa","data/kegg_link_hsa_module.tsv")
```


```{r}
gene_info$kegg_pathway_id <- local({
  p <- read_kegg_link("data/kegg_link_hsa_pathway.tsv")
  p$locus_tag <- factor(p$locus_tag,unique(gene_info$entrezgene_id))
  p <- splitAsList(p$pathway_id,p$locus_tag)
  c(CharacterList(character()),p)[match(gene_info$entrezgene_id,names(p),nomatch = 0)+1L] |> unname() |> unique()
})

gene_info$kegg_module_id <- local({
  p <- read_kegg_link("data/kegg_link_hsa_module.tsv")
  p$locus_tag <- factor(p$locus_tag,unique(gene_info$entrezgene_id))
  p <- splitAsList(p$pathway_id,p$locus_tag)
  c(CharacterList(character()),p)[match(gene_info$entrezgene_id,names(p),nomatch = 0)+1L] |> unname() |> unique()
})
```




# MsigDB (GSEA)

warning: this chunk require user authentication to run => download the zip manually from the website.

```{r,eval=FALSE}
download.file(
  "http://www.gsea-msigdb.org/gsea/msigdb/download_file.jsp?filePath=/msigdb/release/2022.1.Hs/msigdb_v2022.1.Hs_files_to_download_locally.zip",
  "msigdb_v2022.1.Hs_files_to_download_locally.zip"
)
unzip("data/msigdb_v2022.1.Hs_files_to_download_locally.zip","msigdb_v2022.1.Hs_files_to_download_locally/msigdb_v2022.1.Hs_GMTs/msigdb.v2022.1.Hs.entrez.gmt",exdir = "data")
```



```{r}
gene_info$msigdb <- local({
  gmt <- read_gmt("data/msigdb_v2022.1.Hs_files_to_download_locally/msigdb_v2022.1.Hs_GMTs/msigdb.v2022.1.Hs.entrez.gmt")
  gmt <- setNames(gmt$MEMBERS,gmt$STANDARD_NAME) |> 
    stack("msigdb","entrezgene_id")
  gmt$entrezgene_id <- factor(gmt$entrezgene_id,unique(gene_info$entrezgene_id))
  gmt <- splitAsList(as.character(gmt$msigdb),gmt$entrezgene_id)
  c(CharacterList(character()),gmt)[match(gene_info$entrezgene_id,names(gmt),nomatch = 0)+1L] |> unname()
})
```


# Save annotations
```{r}
# binary version
saveRDS(gene_info,"data/gene_info.rds")

# text version
local({
  gene_info <- readRDS("data/gene_info.rds")
  msk <- sapply(gene_info,is,"CharacterList")
  gene_info[msk] <- gene_info[msk] |> lapply(unstrsplit,";")
  write.table(as(gene_info,"data.frame"),"data/gene_info.tsv",sep="\t",row.names = FALSE)
})
```
